image_description: An outdoor concrete staircase leading up to a modern, brutalist-style building with dark cladding. The stairs are flanked by metal handrails (bannisters) on both sides. The left side features a more complex railing system with vertical posts and horizontal bars near the top landing, while the right side has a simpler tubular metal handrail supported by thin vertical stanchions. The background includes a grassy slope and trees under an overcast sky.
